description.text: The specialty can be conducted in English with a prerequisite of a minimum number of 10 students for Master's degree.

duration.text: The International Law at Central South University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK For Chinese-meidum programs. 2.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 3.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 4.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 5.Undergraduate school transcript 6.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 7.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. Applicant should hold Bachelor's Degree or equivalent to a Chinese Bachelor's Degree 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 35
